data.title: 黍 · 谷仓分种
data.description: 谷仓的侧窗照亮一张旧木桌。黍穿农业天师装，将一小撮谷种从掌心拨进浅陶碟，桌边排着几只种袋；挂起的谷穗与窗光里的细尘交代出收储季节。
data.action: 站在木桌前，将掌心谷种逐粒拨入陶碟分类
data.promptProse: At a worn wooden table inside the granary, Shu separates a small handful of grain seeds from her open left palm into a shallow ceramic dish with her right fingertips. Three cloth seed bags sit within reach, with tied grain heads hanging against the rear wall. Her original white-and-blue Tianshi jacket frames the geometric ornaments at her chest. An oblique afternoon sunbeam lights her attentive face and both hands; a vertical medium view includes the dish and the table edge beneath them.
